 Publicidade Choo Young-woo and Kim So-hyun star as Park Min-jae and Im Yoo-jin in Between Steps. When do the next episodes of Between Steps come out?
 New episodes of Between Steps air on Mondays and Tuesdays in South Korea. After Episodes 1 and 2 were released on October 5 and 6, the drama returns with Episode 3 on October 12 .
 Episode 4 follows on October 13 , while Episodes 5 and 6 are scheduled for October 19 and 20 . The same two-episode weekly pattern continues through the end of the series.
 The final week begins with Episode 11 on November 9 , followed by Episode 12 on November 10 , bringing Park Min-jae and Im Yoo-jin’s story to a close.
 Streaming release times may vary by country. The dates above follow the South Korean broadcast schedule and provide the full episode timeline from the premiere through the finale.
 How many episodes does Between Steps have?
 Between Steps has 12 episodes in total. The drama follows Park Min-jae, played by Choo Young-woo, a former competitive swimmer whose life changes after an illness causes him to lose a leg and forces him to rethink the future he had imagined for himself.
 Min-jae eventually finds a new direction through robotics. Kim So-hyun plays Im Yoo-jin, a young woman whose own academic plans also fall apart, leading her to discover a different path inside the same field.
 The two begin growing closer inside a university robotics lab. As they work together and try to rebuild their futures, their unexpected connection slowly develops into something more personal.
 Between Steps follows Yoo-jin and Min-jae as they grow closer through university life, robotics and the search for a new beginning. When does Between Steps end?
 Between Steps is scheduled to end on November 10, 2026, with Episode 12. 
 Publicidade The drama runs for six weeks, beginning on October 5 and releasing two new episodes each week on Mondays and Tuesdays.
 If there are no changes to the broadcast schedule, Episode 11 will arrive on November 9 , followed by the series finale on November 10 .
 Is Between Steps worth watching?
 Between Steps builds its romance around two characters who are forced to reconsider their futures after life takes them in directions they never expected.
 Min-jae finds a new purpose in robotics after leaving competitive swimming behind, while Yoo-jin must also rebuild the plans she once had for herself. Their shared time inside the university lab gradually brings them closer.
 With Kim So-hyun and Choo Young-woo leading the cast, the 12-episode drama combines romance, university life, robotics and the idea of finding a new path after an unexpected setback.
 Where to watch Between Steps
 Between Steps is available on Disney+ in supported territories. The series premiered on October 5, 2026, and has 12 episodes.
 In South Korea, the drama also airs on ENA, with new episodes scheduled for Mondays and Tuesdays. Disney+ availability and release times may vary depending on the region.
 With the first two episodes already released, the next stage of the story begins on October 12 : Episodes 3 and 4 are scheduled for October 12 and 13, while the finale is set for November 10 .
